status: local explicit intent correction verified; actual model quality unmeasured

dimensionDefinitions.meaning: Judge original target use independently. Known incompleteness and missing completion content do not by themselves erase a supported target judgment. Presence alone does not establish correct use. Explicit reply/title/command forms remain separate.
dimensionDefinitions.grammar: Judge original grammar independently of repair availability. In default sentence writing, a known incomplete sentence can be needs_work with no correction and message/relationship context. Unknown grammaticality can remain uncertain. Existing time/quantity uncertainty safeguards are preserved.
dimensionDefinitions.correction: For explicit word contextRole intended_korean, compare completion and meaning repair to the supplied Korean intent; grammatical original English may have a changed correctedSentence. Do not infer a grammar error from that meaning difference. The same AI judges correspondence; no independent app semantic proof is claimed. Without that role, preserve original content under the existing minimal-correction policy.
dimensionDefinitions.explanation: Assess only learner-visible factual claims, reviewed application rules and actual comparisons. Hidden model reasons are diagnostic only. A false visible grammar rule fails this dimension even when the correction is right. App-authored explanations do not certify hidden model-text accuracy.
dimensionDefinitions.abstention: Withhold an unsafe interpretation/correction and ask for the specific missing message, time, quantity, target meaning or relationship. Target-only uncertainty may coexist with an independently justified grammar correction. Ordinary complete pronouns and valid commands do not need named real-world referents. Known target-form error may coexist with withheld correction.

criticalPolicy.approveBadGrammar: Learner-visible approval of known incorrect original grammar; a target-only disagreement or unavailable response is not this error.
criticalPolicy.reverseMeaning: Evidence of an actual meaning reversal, not merely an unconfirmed alternative interpretation.
criticalPolicy.swapRoles: Evidence that a visible correction exchanges participants' semantic roles.
criticalPolicy.inventedIntent: Evidence of an invented agent, event or speech act in the visible product output. A model's raw invention that the product independently withholds is a separate model diagnostic.

wireLabelPolicy: Sufficient original target/grammar assessed independently; grammar uncertain has no correction; known malformed modal with unresolved time prefers grammar uncertain/time question. Actual English-form error and safe correction equivalence are separate dimensions.

sufficiencyRequirements.S1: cause id and counterfactual evidence required; AQ-C01 app evidence is separate from opaque model causes
sufficiencyRequirements.S2: risk/N/r/uncertainty/multiple looks preregistered in T34, not inherited from old30/60 thresholds
sufficiencyRequirements.S3: exposed105 and new regression cases are development only; fresh families/repeats required
sufficiencyRequirements.S4: reviewed wording is not learner understanding; qualified review/comprehension/transfer required
sufficiencyRequirements.S5: Node/synthetic wire/local Worker not production-authenticated AI evidence
sufficiencyRequirements.S6: new issue→synthetic reproduction→cause→fix→fresh evaluation/new approval; bounded day1/day7 review

lexicalBoundary: Recognizable inflection errors are separate from lexical target identity; derivation and actual requested POS remain target-use questions. Grammar lessons assess correct target-feature use. Natural originals keep their text even when the target is wrong/missing.
independentInputBoundary: Unpunctuated token pairs are not independently proven fragments by a verb dictionary. Preserve explicit selected context, reviewed nominal/quantity/relation/location/slash-list guards; otherwise retain the model judgment. This is not a proof that an unconnected verb string is grammatical. A known incomplete wire with needs_work, empty correction/reason, and message/relationship context in sentence-writing mode preserves the model target judgment. Existing bounded guards continue to withhold unsupported confident completions; no new POS or general English rule detector is added.
quantityBoundary: Conflicting number interpretation may keep known target error with grammar uncertain/no correction and the typed quantity question. Resolved context may support either declared minimal alternative. A quantity question cannot accompany settled grammar.
newVersionEffect: Explicit word contextRole intended_korean uses Korean as intended meaning; grammar and target judgments stay about original English. Existing ordinary-context preservation remains. Stored shapes and public contract4 remain unchanged.
verifiedCurrentScope: Node24 unit913/type/lint/build0; built browsers6, correction30, draft40 synthetic checks. Actual new model quality unmeasured.
